title: Alien Isolation Walkthrough Part 1
confidence_note: principles at game level, not frame-accurate timestamps

observations.observation: Industrial corridors, vents, machinery; Sevastopol feels lived-in and coherent, every room has a job.
One unscripted stalker makes every re-traversal tense; sound gives spatial awareness of the threat.
Vents and alternate routes add decision-making to movement; hiding is a real mechanic.
